approval.note: Draft checklist from NCG Guidelines for Adult Hematolymphoid Malignancies (2019) and NCG Guidelines for Pediatric Haematolymphoid and Solid Tumours (2019): needs a clinician's check

site_note: V2 item 5.3 (two primaries): only on a Case File linked to the same patient's other Case File, and only for histopathology, cytology, IHC and molecular records: among several candidates for one record, or several documents carrying a required value, one that names another protocol's site and not this one steps aside and is named on the row for review; a document naming no site never does, and when every candidate names another site every candidate stays. Organ words only. A preference, never a filter; a patient with one cancer is checked as before.
note: DRAFT, not approved for real use: needs a clinician's check. Configurable by the clinical team. Required records transcribed from the National Cancer Grid (India) books: NCG Guidelines for Adult Hematolymphoid Malignancies (2019) (the work-up boxes of the AML, APML, ALL, CLL and CML flow charts, pages 5, 8, 11, 13 and 16, and the flow cytometry annexure, pages 91 to 95) and NCG Guidelines for Pediatric Haematolymphoid and Solid Tumours (2019) (ALL page 7, AML page 13, APML page 15, CML page 17; the printed footer is one less than the PDF page cited). The adult flow charts are pictures with no text layer: their lines were read with the project's own OCR engine (Tesseract) and each such quote is marked ocr and checked against that engine's reading of the page. Four settings group the diseases: where two diseases of one setting carry different letters, the record keeps the higher and its tier_basis names both. Child APML is in the child acute setting, child CML in the child chronic setting. Tiers printed by NCG are kept; the tiers whose tier_basis says 'proposed' are proposals, to be confirmed by the hospital Tumour Board (clinical review before real use). A record NCG gives only under a condition the system never judges (an indication, a finding) is shown with NCG's own tier and the condition, never counted. Leukaemia has no stage: the risk group or phase (for example AML favourable, intermediate or poor risk; CML chronic, accelerated or blast phase) is as recorded in a report, never computed; risk scores are never calculated. Langerhans cell histiocytosis is not in this checklist. Nothing here suggests treatment. India first: the National Cancer Grid books are the only source (the adult book points to the ICMR guideline for flow cytometry quality control, page 91).
settings_note: The setting of the Case File, chosen by the clinician from what the signed reports record (the system never computes a stage or a risk group and never decides the setting; a child is under 15 years as the picker decides, the books give no age cut-off). Each record carries its tier per setting; until a setting is recorded the strictest tier applies. Draft checklist: needs a clinician's check.
